title: SBS aggregate
description: One derived number, recomputable from the raw measurements it references.

methodology.description: Methodology the number was computed under.

version.description: Accepted for one release while the runner stops sending it, and ignored; removed after.

variant.description: Variant id, where the methodology has variants.

sandbox_index.description: Position of the sandbox within its trial, where the number is per position.

value.description: The number, or null when it is unknown (a cost with no provider evidence is null, never zero).

unit.description: Unit of the value and of the interval.

low.description: Lower bound, in the value's unit.

high.description: Upper bound, in the value's unit.

interval.description: Confidence interval, or null when the methodology publishes none for this statistic or the sample is too small.

n.description: Observations the number is computed from.

excluded_n.description: Observations left out for an allowlisted exclusion reason.

inputs.description: Reference to the raw measurements the number is computed from.

relative_to.description: `inputs.relative_to: run` makes `inputs.path` relative to `data/<run_id>/` (for example `raw/true-0000.jsonl`). The default is the repository root. This keeps the exact run identity in its typed field without duplicating it in a free-text path. Reproduction indexes raw files once and selects the referenced file or directory before filtering observations.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the raw measurement file or directory.

group_by.description: `inputs.group_by: workload` with `group_statistic: median` or `first` selects one value per workload before the aggregate's statistic. `n` counts those selected workload values. `statistic: sum` supports trace-set totals; a grouped mean supports averages of job medians. Raw attempts remain available. `not_in_comparison_set` excludes observations outside the methodology's common workload set without discarding them.

group_statistic.description: One value per workload: nearest-rank median or first included observation in file order.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the referenced raw data, so a change is detectable.

filter.description: Measurement fields that select the inputs from the referenced data, as name/value pairs.

precision.description: Comparison precision for the value and interval bounds, in the declared unit. Choose decimal rounding (half a last decimal unit) or an absolute tolerance. No implicit relative tolerance.

test_id.description: Page test identity when several tests share one methodology.
